5.title: HP & SENAI Hackathon
5.image-description1: Coffee Talk: Ricardo Kamel, Managing Director at HP
5.image-description4: Evaluator: Regina Higa, Operations Manager at HP

initial.1: The challenge began with the formation of the groups, bringing together students from two different schools. This made my first obstacle working with people I had not yet met.
initial.2: The main goal was to solve a communication issue HP had with its customers regarding product support. Our solution consisted of creating an accessible communication channel based on an omnichannel approach, enabling more efficient and optimized support for all HP customers.

process.1: There were four intense days of production, followed by a day dedicated to presenting the project. During this period, we went through different stages of planning, research, and development, organizing idea maps, setting priorities, and sharing knowledge among the group members.
process.2: Throughout the entire process, we were also supported by HP representatives and teachers, who were present to guide us, follow our progress, and contribute different perspectives.

final.1: In the end, we became the winners, which gave us an even closer experience with HP. We had the opportunity to visit its factory, recycling center, R&D areas, and laboratories, as well as take part in a Coffee Talk with Ricardo Kamel, Managing Director of HP Brazil, and his team of directors.
final.2: It was an opportunity to present our idea, explore different areas of the company, and understand in practice how HP works to develop its solutions.
